title: Zero served group versions must error explicitly, not be allowed through
answers: Plugin API server fails to start with no clear error after removing settings
InstallSchema or pluginopenapi Build panics/fails silently for a plugin with no served versions
Why must GetGroupVersions never return an empty slice unguarded?
body:
Root cause: once settings can be omitted (includeSettings()==false) and a manifest has no served kinds either, GetGroupVersions() can return an empty slice; generic apiserver's SetVersionPriority requires exactly one+ versions per group and fails deep inside startup with a confusing error if it gets none.
Fix pattern: callers that consume GetGroupVersions must check len(gvs)==0 and return a clear error immediately — done in pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/register.go:InstallSchema ("plugin %s has no served versions") and pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/pluginopenapi/spec.go:Build.
Constraints: apply this check anywhere GetGroupVersions/Versions() output is relied on to be non-empty before touching the scheme or OpenAPI builder.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/appplugin and pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/pluginopenapi, wherever GetGroupVersions/Versions() output feeds scheme or OpenAPI building
says: Plugin API startup fails unclear when no types configured
Plugin crashes confusingly after optional settings are removed
Plugin server doesn't explain why it won't start
Plugin initialization fails with unclear error about missing configuration
Removing plugin settings causes silent API startup failure
search: GetGroupVersions() in pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/register.go can return an empty slice when settings are omitted and no served kinds exist, causing deep startup failures in SetVersionPriority rather than clear errors. Callers must check len(gvs)==0 and return explicit errors immediately—implemented in pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/register.go:InstallSchema with message "plugin %s has no served versions" and pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/pluginopenapi/spec.go:Build. This validation applies wherever GetGroupVersions() or Versions() output feeds into scheme or OpenAPI builder operations that require at least one version. The constraint prevents confusing deep-stack initialization errors by catching zero versions early in pkg/registry/apis/appplugin and pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/pluginopenapi.
